description: List the Cursor pages (canvases) in your Library, newest first. The Library is the user's whole store: pages written by this run, by earlier runs, by other bots and threads, and by the person, so a listed page is not necessarily this run's output. Each entry carries canvas_id, url, sharing (private, team, or public: who can open it), and when it was updated. Filter by title `query` or `updated_after`. Read a page with ReadCanvas, or change one with EditCanvas, by its canvas_id.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against page titles.

updated_after.description: Only pages updated at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp.
